source_identity.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

scope: Part 2 Core, Tables 1–4, printed pages 22–33: all 72 subcategories. 71 prior records preserved and two atomic records added for missing MANAGE 4.3.
excluded_material: Part 1 conceptual framing and trustworthy characteristics are interpretive context, not additional extracted controls.
Function-level narrative, category headings, Profiles, appendices and companion Playbook are outside this bounded control extraction.
unresolved_issues: 71 retained records still need individual atomicity and applicability-field review. Some controls combine separately assessable outcomes.
Reverse taxonomy coverage is pending. No reviewed relationship is admitted by this ledger.
No assertion of human verification or whole-framework completion.
